Delle Navigationi et Viaggi, Vol. 1 (Giovanni Battista Ramusio, 1550)
==========================================================
Ramusio's Navigationi et Viaggi (1550-59) - the FIRST great voyage collection, the model for Hakluyt and Purchas; first printed home of Marco Polo's complete text and the African and Asian voyages. Venetian Giunti editions (Italian). Vol. 1 of 3.
